name: Anthropic — AI-native SDLC playbook
summary: A playbook of plays across six stages in which each stage commits an artifact (intent.md, spec.md, plan.md, PR, incident record) that triggers the next, with humans approving at the gates.
source_phases: Plan · Design · Build · Test · Deploy · Maintain

members.responsibility: Describes the problem to Claude in their own words and corrects the resulting intent.md.

citation.section: Plan — Capture as intent.md (How to execute it)

members.responsibility: Reviews and corrects intent.md, approves it, and reviews and signs off spec.md.

citation.section: Plan — Capture as intent.md; Design — Requirements and design

members.responsibility: Resolves flagged spec concerns with the product owner; signs off changes to the skill that encodes the policy.

citation.section: Design — Requirements and design; Build — Skills as institutional knowledge

members.v21_note: Higher-risk plans go to a 'tech lead or architect' (Build — plan mode).
members.responsibility: Writes REVIEW.md, sets the human review threshold and tunes review findings monthly.

citation.section: Deploy — AI in the PR review loop (How to execute it)

members.responsibility: Iterates on and approves plan.md in plan mode, then steers several parallel Claude Code sessions.

citation.section: Build — Claude Code plan mode as the default starting point; Parallel sessions and subagents

members.responsibility: Drafts the plan in plan mode, then implements code and tests; can run in auto mode once the plan is approved.

citation.section: Build — Claude Code plan mode as the default starting point; Claude Code on auto mode

members.responsibility: Subagent that explores the codebase and reports back without flooding the main context.

citation.section: Build — Parallel sessions and subagents (How to execute it)

members.responsibility: Subagent that strips needless complexity after the main agent finishes.

citation.section: Build — Parallel sessions and subagents (How to execute it)

members.responsibility: Subagent that runs the app, checks the change against plan.md and reports; it does not fix anything.

citation.section: Build — Parallel sessions and subagents (.claude/agents/verifier.md)

members.v21_note: Managed Code Review service (research preview) or claude-code-action in CI.
members.responsibility: Runs the REVIEW.md passes (Bugs, Security, Compliance) on every PR; findings alone neither approve nor block.

citation.section: Deploy — AI in the PR review loop

members.responsibility: Approves the PR through branch protection; the agent that wrote the code has no way to approve it.

citation.section: Deploy — AI in the PR review loop (Governance considerations); Test — Give Claude a feedback loop

members.v21_note: No v2.1 equivalent; the platform team also owns managed settings.
members.responsibility: Collects eval tasks, expresses approval gates as hooks and runs Claude non-interactively in CI/CD.

citation.section: Test — Continuous evals in CI; Deploy — Hooks as approval gates; CI/CD integration and deployment

members.responsibility: Authorizes production releases; a hook blocks the production deploy until a named release manager signs off.

citation.section: Deploy — CI/CD integration and deployment (Governance considerations)

members.responsibility: Diagnoses a breached control band and writes it up as a new intent.md; acts only through gated routes.

citation.section: Maintain — Maintenance and closing the loop

members.v21_note: No v2.1 equivalent; v2.1 routes alert-born intent.md to product_owner.
members.responsibility: Picks the metric and detection script, then triages agent findings: fix now, schedule, or dismiss.

citation.section: Maintain — Closing the loop (How to execute it)

members.responsibility: Connects repositories to scheduled Claude Security scans and organizes them so finding ownership is clear.

citation.section: Maintain — Recurring codebase scans (How to execute it)

gaps.text: No Scrum Master role is defined.

citation.section: §4 Tabla comparativa de roles (row 'Scrum master')

gaps.text: In the AI-native process the human architect appears once, as the 'tech lead or architect' who approves higher-risk plans (the other mention describes the traditional SDLC).

citation.section: Build — Claude Code plan mode as the default starting point (Governance considerations)

gaps.text: Architecture rules are context (CLAUDE.md) checked by in-session hooks and an LLM Compliance review pass; the playbook does not propose them as deterministic CI checks.

citation.section: §5.1 Reglas de arquitectura verificadas en CI (fitness functions) — Anthropic

gaps.text: Cross-repository work is barely addressed: a dedicated intent repo is suggested only when intent spans many repositories; CLAUDE.md, hooks and review are per repo.

citation.section: §5.2 Cambios que cruzan repositorios — Anthropic
